reviews.title: Awsome Mouse Pad
reviews.comment: Great mouse pad for gaming, smooth glide effortless.  I have a new Razer Basilisk V3 that I bought with it and I love the mouse and pad. Had a aluminum pad before and it was great but glass is the way to go. Its bigger by just a little bit and it still fits. There is some noise when it glide around but I wear headsets so I really don't hear it but if you don't it might be a problem. Overall, I am very satisfied in my purchase.
reviews.author: Kenneth D. Wilson

reviews.title: Best glass pad for the price, smooth and silent
reviews.comment:
For my first glass mouse pad, the quality is honestly amazing. The mouse glides across the surface so easily, and it’s surprisingly quiet—almost no noise at all when I’m moving fast.
The carbon design looks super clean and fits the vibe of my setup perfectly. It's the ideal size for gaming, especially if you need that extra space for flicks, and the price is a total steal for how it performs. Plus, it’s a breeze to keep clean. 10/10 would recommend if you’re looking to upgrade your tracking.
reviews.author: Joseph Williams

reviews.title: Solid gaming mousepad
reviews.comment: Overall, it's a nice mousepad. It would have gotten 5 stars, but there is a slight texture to the mousepad that make a noise that I am not a fan of. It's hardly noticable, but when it does, I get annoyed. The mouse glides nicely, especially when gaming.
reviews.author: Jim Y

reviews.title: Better than the super expensive ones!
reviews.comment: My sons a gamer, he begged me for one that was almost $200 based on popularity. Found this option while comparing products and took a chance on it. Im glad i did! He loves it! The quality on it is good. The size is perfect. He still thinks i splurged on it so i told him to take care of it although the quality of it is good im sure it will last. Some advice however, he had me buy some "glass" rubber feet for his mouse, and apparently theyre not required but they work better with it. I tried it and its smoother and quiet, he said if you dont swap the feet a regular mouse not only will be loud but it will scratch the mouse pad.
reviews.author: Jose Arreguin
